summary: Phase 20 converts the Phase 19 multi-pass modeling policy from documentation into machine-enforced bridge invariants in bridge_cli.py verify-report. Two rounds of controller review corrections closed all identified trust-boundary bypasses.

round_1.bypass_1: Authorization read from result manifest → fixed: read from base manifest only.
round_1.bypass_2: Payload files absent at base silently skipped modification check → fixed: base manifest absent + result manifest present is now a hard PROVENANCE_ERROR (fabrication).
round_1.bypass_3: result_commit not validated as real git object or HEAD → fixed: git cat-file -e and git rev-parse HEAD checks added.

round_2.bypass_4: Operator deletes manifest.json on result commit → verification classified task as non-payload and skipped all checks. Fixed: payload-task detection now driven by base_commit. base present + result absent = PROVENANCE_ERROR (deletion attack).
round_2.bypass_5: Authorized Codex task allowed to modify any manifest field, not just sha256. Operator could rewrite modeling_run_id, pass_index, author_role, etc., subverting the multi-pass state machine. Fixed: all controller-owned fields except sha256 must remain byte-identical to base manifest. Violation = MANIFEST_CONTRACT_ERROR. Downstream checks use an authoritative manifest built from base contract + verified result sha256.

trust_boundary_rules.payload_task_detection: Base-commit manifest presence determines payload-task status. base absent + result absent = non-payload. base absent + result present = fabrication FAIL. base present + result absent = deletion FAIL. base present + result present = full validation.
trust_boundary_rules.authorization_source: base_commit manifest only — operator cannot self-authorize.
trust_boundary_rules.payload_immutability_unauthorized: result manifest and rhino.py must be byte-for-byte identical to base when local_modeling_authorized=false.
trust_boundary_rules.authorized_modification_scope: local_modeling_authorized=true permits rhino.py and manifest.sha256 to change only. All other controller-owned fields (task_id, author_role, modeling_run_id, pass_index, pass_kind, parent lineage, etc.) must remain identical to base.
trust_boundary_rules.authoritative_manifest_downstream: Lineage and pass-evaluation checks receive a manifest built from base contract values + verified result sha256, preventing any operator-modified field from reaching downstream checks.
trust_boundary_rules.result_commit_validated: Must exist as a git object and equal current HEAD at verify time.
trust_boundary_rules.review_signal: Parent report presence at base_commit is the machine proxy for controller review/merge of the parent pass.

invariants_implemented.description: Payload-task detection from base commit: base absent + result absent → non-payload (return None). base absent + result present → fabrication FAIL. base present + result absent → deletion FAIL.
author_role=controller checked at base_commit.
rhino.py must exist at both base and result commits (deletion = FAIL).
Base integrity: SHA-256 of base rhino.py must match base manifest.sha256.
Self-authorization prevention: local_modeling_authorized read from base only; result cannot grant additional authority.
Unauthorized immutability: when local_modeling_authorized=false, result manifest and rhino.py must be byte-for-byte identical to base.
Authorized SHA check: when local_modeling_authorized=true, result rhino.py SHA-256 must match result manifest.sha256.
Manifest contract immutability: when authorized, only sha256 may differ; all other controller-owned fields must match base manifest.
Authoritative manifest: downstream checks receive base contract + verified result sha256, never operator-modified fields.
result_commit existence: git cat-file -e must succeed.
result_commit = HEAD: current HEAD must equal report.result_commit at verify time.
Multi-pass activation: triggered by non-empty modeling_run_id in authoritative manifest.
pass_index positive integer; pass_kind in valid enum; requires_controller_review_after boolean if present.
Foundation pass (non-hotfix): reject parent lineage fields.
pass_index > 1: require parent fields; resolve from base_commit; parent report must exist at base (controller-review signal).
Parent report result_commit, manifest sha256, modeling_run_id, and pass_index+1 must all match.
Multi-pass tasks must commit pass-evaluation.json at result_commit.
pass-evaluation fields match authoritative manifest.
operator_recommendation_scope must be 'evidence_only'.
When local_modeling_authorized=false: reject local_modeling_used=true or payload_modified_by_operator=true in pass-evaluation.

backward_compatibility.non_payload_tasks: No manifest at either base or result → all Phase-20 checks skipped.
backward_compatibility.single_pass_payload_tasks: Manifest without modeling_run_id → provenance checked, lineage and pass-evaluation skipped.

new_command.name: next-pass-context
new_command.description: Non-mutating helper: prints lineage JSON for controller's next pass. Does not author geometry.

files_changed.change: Complete provenance trust-boundary with all bypass fixes. Payload-task detection from base_commit. Authorized manifest contract enforcement. Authoritative manifest construction. result_commit existence and HEAD-match checks. next-pass-context command.
29-case fixture test suite. All verify-report calls before receipt commit. Covers all 20 invariants and all known bypass attack vectors.
Added provenance fields: local_modeling_used, local_modeling_authorized, payload_modified_by_operator, provenance_check.
Updated with enforcement notices and canonical pass-evaluation path.
Updated multi-pass loop with canonical path and enforcement notice.

validations.json_valid: All modified JSON files validated via json.load
validations.rhino_runtime_unchanged: No Rhino/MCP runtime implementation files modified

known_limitations: next-pass-context reads from the current working tree, not a specific commit. Run from a clean up-to-date checkout after parent pass is merged.
Parent report presence at base_commit is the controller-review proxy; no cryptographic signature.
Pass-evaluation free-form fields (measurements, capture_artifacts) are not schema-checked.
verify-report runs git commands from ROOT; calling outside a git repository produces a subprocess error rather than a clear bridge error.
